description: This Java test source file contains JUnit 5 unit tests verifying the correct multi-tenant behavior of the MoneyHelper utility class within the Apache Fineract project. It tests tenant isolation on configuration settings like rounding modes and MathContext, cache invalidation, and proper handling of tenant contexts in a multi-tenant environment.

classes.name: MoneyHelperTenantIsolationTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class to verify multi-tenant isolation and configuration correctness of the MoneyHelper utility in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test tenants and clears cache before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores original tenant context and clears cache after each test.

methods.name: testProperTenantIsolationWithPureUtilityClass
methods.description: Verifies that different tenants have isolated RoundingMode configurations.

methods.name: testProperMathContextIsolation
methods.description: Ensures tenant-specific MathContext instances are used, with distinct rounding modes.

methods.name: testRealWorldMultiTenantSequence
methods.description: Simulates calculations in different tenant contexts to verify proper configuration usage.

methods.description: Checks that tenants abide by their respective regulatory rounding rules.

methods.name: testPerformanceBenefits

methods.name: testCalculationWithActualRoundingDifferences
methods.description: Demonstrates differences in rounding behaviors across tenants with different modes.
